package.name: curl
package.description: URL retrieval utility and library (Werewolf HTTP(S)-only policy)

pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://github.com/curl/curl.git; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" 3163ec065643ba20709f190111f42c3e1fe95273; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 3163ec065643ba20709f190111f42c3e1fe95273
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach 3163ec065643ba20709f190111f42c3e1fe95273
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "3163ec065643ba20709f190111f42c3e1fe95273: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

pipeline.name: Run upstream test suite
pipeline.runs:
if grep -q '^test-nonflaky:' Makefile; then
  target=test-nonflaky
else
  target=test
fi
log=$(mktemp)
start=$(date +%s)
rc=0
# Named exceptions (curl runtests "!N" syntax):
#   2095 HTTPS client auth via CURLOPT_SSLCERT_BLOB: the test server resets the
#        connection after the handshake in the CI (qemu) runner on x86_64 and
#        aarch64; it passes in a local docker runner.
# TODO(upstream-tests): investigate 2095 and drop it from the exclusion list.
make $target TFLAGS="-j$(nproc) !2095 !netrc" > "$log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
cat "$log"
echo "UPSTREAM-TESTS ${{package.name}}: duration=$(( $(date +%s)-start ))s"
done_line=$(grep -E '^TESTDONE: [0-9]+ tests out of [0-9]+ reported OK' "$log" | tail -n1 || true)
if [ -n "$done_line" ]; then
  ok=$(echo "$done_line" | sed -n 's/^TESTDONE: \([0-9]*\) tests out of \([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  total=$(echo "$done_line" | sed -n 's/^TESTDONE: \([0-9]*\) tests out of \([0-9]*\).*/\2/p')
  skip=$(grep -E '^TESTINFO: [0-9]+ tests were skipped' "$log" | tail -n1 | sed -n 's/^TESTINFO: \([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' || true)
  echo "UPSTREAM-TESTS ${{package.name}}: pass=$ok fail=$((total-ok)) skip=${skip:-0}"
else
  echo "UPSTREAM-TESTS ${{package.name}}: pass=unknown fail=unknown skip=unknown"
fi
rm -f "$log"
exit $rc

wait-for-it localhost:8080
